description: This file defines React components for breadcrumb navigation UI, including various subcomponents like BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, etc., using JSX syntax and TypeScript types.

methods.name: Breadcrumb
methods.description: React component rendering a nav element with aria-label for breadcrumb navigation.

methods.name: BreadcrumbList
methods.description: React component rendering an ordered list (<ol>) for breadcrumb items with styling classes.

methods.name: BreadcrumbItem
methods.description: React component rendering a list item (<li>) for individual breadcrumb entry.

methods.name: BreadcrumbLink
methods.description: React component rendering an anchor (<a>) with optional 'asChild' prop for custom element or Slot integration.

methods.name: BreadcrumbPage
methods.description: React component rendering a span acting as the current page indicator in breadcrumb.

methods.name: BreadcrumbSeparator
methods.description: React component rendering separator element, typically an icon, between breadcrumb items.

methods.name: BreadcrumbEllipsis
methods.description: React component showing an ellipsis with a icon, used when breadcrumb items are truncated.
